proposedOperatorData.name: Plas y Brenin
proposedOperatorData.tagline: Wales' National Outdoor Centre for climbing, mountaineering, paddling and biking in the heart of Snowdonia
proposedOperatorData.description:
Plas y Brenin is the National Outdoor Centre for Wales, based in Capel Curig at the foot of the Snowdonia mountains. Managed by the Mountain Training Trust on behalf of Sport England, it has operated as a training and activity hub for outdoor pursuits for decades, offering instructor-led courses spanning climbing (rock, bouldering, scrambling), hill walking and mountain leadership training, white water and sea kayaking, mountain biking, and winter mountaineering skills (in Wales and Scotland).

The centre combines residential accommodation, an on-site bar and restaurant (Lolfa'r Wyddfa), indoor climbing and bouldering walls, and equipment hire with courses that range from taster sessions for beginners to professional qualification training for aspiring instructors. It also runs corporate away-days, family and group experiences, and youth summer camps for ages 12-17.
proposedOperatorData.uniqueSellingPoint: Wales' official National Outdoor Centre — a long-established, professionally accredited training hub (not just a single-activity provider) offering everything from beginner tasters to National Governing Body instructor qualifications, with on-site residential accommodation in Capel Curig.
